title: The Medical book on the shelf
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：medical　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 medical 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the painter wrote of ① a medical book on the shelf in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② so medical that nobody in the studio would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the medical ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the medical book on the shelf that anybody there had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too medical to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the medical ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a medical team in the village, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as medical as the team in the village they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was medical or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something medical, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite medical; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the medical ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another medical book on the shelf in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less medical than anybody had expected. ⑩ The medical team in the village that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the medical ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 医学（前置定语 a medical book on the shelf：1991 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件医学的书）
B. adj. 医学／医疗（两处加强说法：so medical that … 与 no less medical than …）
C. adj. 医学／医疗（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 医学（表语 too medical to do：母亲觉得它太医学，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 医疗（前置定语 a medical team in the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩医疗的队）
F. adj. 医疗（同级比较 as medical as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里的医疗队相比）
G. adj. 医疗（后置定语 something medical：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 医疗（受程度副词修饰 quite medical：那位观者的评价）

items.q: a medical book on the shelf
the medical book on the shelf that
a medical team in the village
The medical team in the village that

answers.why: medical 意为“医学”，1991 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件医学的书”，此处作前置定语 a medical book on the shelf。
medical 意为“医学”，此处用 so medical that 结构，说它医学到画室里没人敢靠近。
medical 意为“医学”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的医学架上的医学书，等于最高级的说法。
medical 意为“医学”，母亲认为这件东西“太医学了，谁也用不上”，too medical to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
medical 意为“医疗”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩医疗的队”，此处作前置定语 a medical team in the village。
medical 意为“医疗”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里的医疗队一样医疗”，同级比较用 as medical as。
medical 意为“医疗”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“医疗的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something medical。
medical 意为“医疗”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当医疗”，quite 修饰原级 medical。
medical 意为“医疗”，no less medical than 表示“其医疗不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之医疗不亚于任何人的预料。
medical 意为“医疗”，母亲 2003 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的医疗队”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件医学的书。（a medical book on the shelf）
它医学到画室里没有一个人敢靠近。（so medical that …）
母亲觉得它太医学，谁也用不上。（too medical to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩医疗的队。（a medical team in the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里的医疗队一样医疗。（as medical as …）
到了 1998 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件医疗的东西。（something medical）
answers: In 1991 the painter wrote of a medical book on the shelf in the catalogue.
It was so medical that nobody in the studio would go near it.
My mother thought it too medical to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a medical team in the village.
He said nobody would call it as medical as the team in the village they had once had.
By 1998 the catalogue asked for nothing but something medical.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 medical 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the painter wrote of a medical book on the shelf in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the medical book on the shelf that anybody there had ever seen, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too medical to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a medical team in the village, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite medical, and everybody laughed.
The medical ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
